title: The Treatise of Ordered Tempest
summary: A treatise on holding the stream of order and the stream of chaos in one hand until the storm itself obeys a pattern.

title: Manual of the Measured Interval
summary: A manual on joining the stream of order to the stream of space so that every distance becomes a fixed law.

title: The Canon of Written Destiny
summary: A canon on joining the stream of order to the stream of fate until an outcome is written down and must be so.
